name: compute_bmi
description: Calculate the Body Mass Index (BMI) based on a person's weight in kilograms and height in meters. Use this tool when you need to assess whether an individual has a healthy body weight relative to their height. Do NOT use this tool for other health assessments or calculations unrelated to BMI.

parameters.name: weight_kg
parameters.description: The weight of the person in kilograms. Must be a positive number greater than 0. For example, 70.5.

parameters.name: height_m
parameters.description: The height of the person in meters. Must be a positive number greater than 0. For example, 1.75.

bmi.description: The calculated Body Mass Index (BMI) value, which is a dimensionless number.

category.description: The BMI category based on the calculated value (e.g., 'Underweight', 'Normal weight', 'Overweight', 'Obesity').

return_schema.description: Object containing the calculated BMI value and the corresponding weight category.
